source: R package drc (Ritz C, Baty F, Streibig JC, Gerhard D (2015) Dose-Response Analysis Using R. PLOS ONE 10(12): e0146021), datasets 'ryegrass' and 'lettuce', copied from the Rdatasets CSV export of drc (https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/drc/ryegrass.csv and .../lettuce.csv, retrieved 2026-11-23).

ryegrass.about: Root length (cm) of perennial ryegrass against ferulic acid concentration (mM); Inderjit, Streibig JC, Olofsdotter M (2002) Weed Biol Manag 2:28-36.

lettuce.about: Shoot biomass (g) of lettuce against isobutylalcohol concentration (mg/l); van Ewijk PH, Hoekstra JA (1993) Ecotoxicol Environ Saf 25:25-32.

ryegrass_LL3.citation: Ritz et al. (2015) PLOS ONE 10:e0146021, S1 File 'Five illustrative examples', Example 2, summary(drm(rootl ~ conc, data = ryegrass, fct = LL.3())) and ED(..., c(5, 10, 50), interval = 'delta'), pages 2-3.
